svg.title: The Gomu Gomu snake devours the contribution graph
svg.desc: A GitHub-style contribution calendar for the last year with 110 contributions over 20 active days. Colour shows intensity, from pale for quiet days through gold to crimson for the busiest. A short gold snake wearing a straw hat slithers out of the left margin, eats every active day week by week, and leaves on the right while the grid regrows. One lap takes about 21 seconds.
svg.text: 20 active days · best day 19 on Sep 28 · longest streak 2 days, Jan 26–27
